_doc: The rules of a game's world that every player takes for granted, for the trace-fix skill. Each is judged twice: in a photo (what to look for) and in the code (the state it limits: `ledger.py writers <state> --rule` gives every function that writes it). A fix that can reach the screen answers every rule (`fix --checked`): ok, not in view, or the problem recorded.

rules.rule: No two solid bodies stand in one another: vehicles, people, buildings, props, trees, the ground.
rules.photo: A vehicle through another or through a wall, a person inside a car or a post, a tree in a building, anything cut by the ground.
rules.state: the pose of everything that moves, and the place of everything that is put down

rules.rule: Bodies keep their distance as they move: a queue has gaps, nobody pushes through.
rules.photo: Bumpers touching or overlapping in a queue, people in a knot on one spot.
rules.state: the gap each mover keeps to what is ahead of it, on every way it can move (a lane, a junction, a manoeuvre off the lanes)

rules.rule: Everything rests on what carries it: nothing floats, nothing is sunk.
rules.photo: Wheels above or below the road, feet off the ground, a building on a step of air, a prop hanging.
rules.state: the height of each thing and the height of the ground or deck under it

rules.rule: Surfaces meet: no gap, seam, hole or overlap between ground, road, kerb, footway, lot and water.
rules.photo: A dark line or a see-through slit between two surfaces, two surfaces fighting on one place, a strip of grass between a footway and a lot's front.
rules.state: the outline and the heights each surface is built from, and who cuts the ground under a road

rules.rule: Motion is continuous: nothing jumps, turns on the spot or changes place between two frames.
rules.photo: In a sequence: a vehicle or a person at one place in one frame and far from it in the next.
rules.state: every write of a pose that is not a step of the motion law (a reset, a re-entry, a correction)

rules.rule: Nothing is made or taken away where the player may see it.
rules.photo: In a sequence: a vehicle, a person or a building there in one frame and gone in the next, or the reverse, inside the view.
rules.state: where things are born and removed, and the test of sight before each

rules.rule: Nothing stands for good with its way free; nothing moves with its way shut.
rules.photo: A vehicle or a person still across several frames with nothing ahead; one driving through a red light or through a crossing in use.
rules.state: what each mover waits for, and who releases it

rules.rule: Each mover keeps to its place: vehicles to their lanes and direction, people to footways and crossings.
rules.photo: A car on a footway or against the flow, a person walking in the carriageway away from a crossing.
rules.state: the lane or the path each mover is on, and every way it can leave it

rules.rule: Everything drawn has its surface: no missing, stretched, repeated or wrongly coloured texture.
rules.photo: A flat grey or magenta face, a texture smeared along a wall, the same tile in a visible grid, a colour that belongs to another thing.
rules.state: the material and the coordinates each mesh is built with

rules.rule: Nothing flickers: two faces never share a place, nothing shimmers as the camera moves.
rules.photo: In a sequence or in one frame: a noisy patch, stripes on a flat face, a surface that changes between frames with nothing moving.
rules.state: faces built at the same place by two owners, and what is redrawn every frame

rules.rule: A change of detail is not seen: near and far show the same thing at the same place.
rules.photo: A building, a tree or a road that changes shape, colour or place at some distance; a thing present near and absent far (or the reverse).
rules.state: the levels each thing is drawn in and the distance each one is switched at

rules.rule: Light makes sense: a shadow touches what casts it, a light has a source, day and night are what the clock says.
rules.photo: A shadow apart from its object or missing under it, a lit patch with no lamp, a lamp that lights nothing, a dark face in full sun.
rules.state: who casts and who lights, and the hour the light and the sky are set from

rules.rule: What the interface says is what the game holds.
rules.photo: A number, a name or a marker on the screen that the scene in the same photo contradicts.
rules.state: the snapshot the interface reads and who writes each value of it

rules.rule: One owner writes each piece of state, and undo, redo, save and open return the same city.
rules.state: the writers of each member: more than one owner, or a write outside the commands and the simulation

rules.rule: The work of a frame follows what changed, not the size of the city.
rules.state: what each frame and each tick rebuild, send or ask again when nothing they depend on moved
